name: Shokz Bone Conduction Open-Ear Bluetooth Headphones
description: Shokz bone-conduction open-ear Bluetooth headphones in excellent condition. These rest on your cheekbones and vibrate sound through your bones, leaving your ear canals completely open — so you hear your music AND your surroundings. Ideal for running, cycling, commuting, and gym workouts where situational awareness matters. Extremely lightweight, comfortable for all-day wear, sweat resistant, and pair instantly over Bluetooth. Excellent working and cosmetic condition, thoroughly cleaned before listing. From a pet-friendly home (a cat lives here) but sanitized. Does NOT come with an additional storage bag — please bring your own pouch for pickup.

name_zh: 韶音（Shokz）骨传导开放式蓝牙耳机（成色极佳）
description_zh: 转让韶音（Shokz）骨传导开放式蓝牙耳机，成色极佳。耳机贴合颧骨震动传声，耳道完全开放——听音乐的同时也能听到周围环境声，非常适合跑步、骑行、通勤或健身房等需要保持环境感知的场景。机身极轻、适合全天佩戴，防汗，蓝牙秒连。成色与功能均为极佳状态，发布前已彻底清洁。此前来自养猫的家庭，请知悉。不附带额外收纳袋，自提请自备小袋。（请确认具体型号：OpenRun / OpenMove 等。）
